High Priest of the nation of [[Tresycht]], '''Gellack''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Saurton]]. Along with the help of the [[Messert Mines Corporation]], Gellack took control of the planet [[Essowyn]] and organized what evolved into the [[Council of Elders (Saurton)|Council of Elders]].
